verdict.rationale: Dagster documents a set of maintained integrations for common data-stack tools—dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt—letting engineers represent syncs/loads as assets, which covers a real slice of 'connectors for SaaS APIs, databases, and files.' However, the evidence only shows a handful of named integrations rather than a broad catalog spanning many SaaS APIs/databases, and community commentary notes Airflow has a maturity/integration-breadth advantage over Dagster, indicating the catalog is narrower than category leaders. Missing for 10: evidence of a large, broad connector catalog (e.g., dozens of SaaS/DB/file connectors), first-party connector directory page, and independent confirmation of connector coverage breadth.
